notes: Guidance for composing admitted Spek sections; not a source selection or semantic authority. Each layout inherits typed slot rules from layouts/*.json, never duplicated here.

carte-jalons-preuves.label: Milestone and Proof Map
carte-jalons-preuves.integrity_rule: A shortcut edge does not constitute proof; pin exact proof references.

compilation-collection.label: Compilation / Collection
compilation-collection.integrity_rule: Curation does not imply ownership of every included item.

composition-hybride.label: Hybrid Composition
composition-hybride.integrity_rule: Do not merge semantic owners or treat application logic as canon.

deposition-temoignage.label: Testimony / Deposition
deposition-temoignage.integrity_rule: Reported claims are not automatically verified facts.

diagnostic-causal.label: Causal Diagnosis
diagnostic-causal.integrity_rule: Inferences are not permissions to perform interventions.

dossier-suivi.label: Casefile / Follow-Up
dossier-suivi.integrity_rule: Sensitive assessments and decisions require explicit governance.

etat-systemes.label: System-State Matrix
etat-systemes.integrity_rule: Observed, desired and inferred states must remain separate.

federation-topologie.label: Federation / Topology
federation-topologie.integrity_rule: A parent reference does not own or absorb a child state.

interpretations-couches.label: Layered Interpretations
interpretations-couches.integrity_rule: Keep interpretation and reproducible source distinct.

invariant-theorie.label: Invariant / Formal Theory
invariant-theorie.integrity_rule: Proof obligations need real justification and scope.

memoire-recherche.label: Research Memory
memoire-recherche.integrity_rule: Preserve the difference between hypotheses and established findings.

modele-multiplexe.label: Multiplex / Organizational Model
modele-multiplexe.integrity_rule: Avoid collapsing relationships from different layers.

parcours-pedagogique.label: Learning Path
parcours-pedagogique.integrity_rule: Learning projection is not the whole knowledge base.

procedure-protocole.label: Procedure / Protocol
procedure-protocole.integrity_rule: Description, execution and authorization are different.

referentiel-semantique.label: Semantic Reference
referentiel-semantique.integrity_rule: Distinguish assertions from instructional projections and record sources.

registre-evenementiel.label: Event Ledger / Chronology
registre-evenementiel.integrity_rule: An event log is not necessarily current state or causal proof.

simulation-transition.label: Simulation / Transitions
simulation-transition.integrity_rule: Simulation does not grant real-world execution authority.

taxonomie-classification.label: Taxonomy / Natural Classification
taxonomie-classification.integrity_rule: Classification criteria, authority and exceptions must be explicit.

univers-oeuvres-medias.label: Media and Creative Universes
univers-oeuvres-medias.integrity_rule: Preserve provenance and distinction between work and interpretation.
